resources.string: Firmware needed. Use the private local firmware installer, then tap Retry. No firmware is included.
Could not open this pet. Firmware or save may be incompatible or damaged. Existing data was kept. Back up the app data and check the local setup guide before retrying.
Save failed. Your current pet is still held in memory. Free watch storage, then tap Retry. Do not force stop or uninstall the app.
Emulation stopped. Your pet is still held in memory. Tap Retry to resume. If this repeats, pause and check the local setup guide.
Latest save not confirmed. Reopen Tamaemu to retry before force stopping.
The previous session ended before its final save was confirmed. Tap Retry to restore your latest checkpoint. Some recent progress may be missing.
The previous session ended without a confirmed final save, and no checkpoint was found. Existing files were kept. Back up the app data and check the local setup guide.
